youtube.title: George Washington never chopped the cherry tree. This guy made it up 🍒 #shorts
youtube.caption:
The George Washington cherry tree story? Totally made up 🍒

Team George or Team Weems? Pick one 👇

Parody · fictional chat. Based on history: Parson Mason Locke Weems added the "I cannot tell a lie" cherry tree tale to the 5th edition of his Washington biography in 1806, years after Washington died. There's no evidence it ever happened, but it ended up in school books for generations.

#georgewashington #cherrytree #americanhistory #historymyths #foundingfathers #historymemes #shorts
